title: WhatsApp
description: Send trip reminders and recaps from your shop's own WhatsApp number, so divers recognise who is messaging them.

status.notConnectedDescription: Courtesy reminders and recaps are going out as SMS.

setup.heading: How connecting works
setup.step1: Press Connect. Meta opens its own window, where you sign in with the Facebook account that manages your shop.
setup.step2: Choose the phone number you want divers to hear from, or add a new one, and accept Meta's terms.
setup.step3: That's it. DiveDay registers the number and submits your message template for approval on your behalf.

test.heading: Send a test message
test.phoneDescription: In full international form, starting with the country code.

disconnect.heading: Disconnect
disconnect.description: Removes your stored token and returns courtesy messages to SMS. Your WhatsApp account and templates are untouched.

notice.disconnected: WhatsApp disconnected. Courtesy messages will go out as SMS.
notice.test-failed: WhatsApp rejected the test message. Check that your token is still valid and your template is approved in the language shown above.
notice.invalid: Check the details and try again.
notice.not-authorized: Only an owner or manager can change WhatsApp settings.
notice.no-account: No WhatsApp number is connected yet.
notice.encryption-key-unset: This DiveDay instance is not set up to store credentials securely yet, so nothing was saved.
notice.encryption-key-invalid: This DiveDay instance's encryption key is misconfigured, so nothing was saved.
notice.signup-unavailable: WhatsApp connecting isn't switched on for this DiveDay instance yet.
notice.signup-failed-exchange: Meta didn't accept the connection. Press Connect to start again.
notice.signup-failed-register: Meta couldn't activate that phone number for sending. It may already be in use with the WhatsApp app — remove it there first, then try again.
notice.signup-failed-subscribe: Your number connected, but DiveDay couldn't subscribe to its delivery updates. Press Connect to try again.
notice.signup-failed-template: Your number connected, but the message template couldn't be submitted for approval. Press Connect to try again.

comingSoon.heading: Coming soon
comingSoon.body: Connecting your WhatsApp number goes through Meta's approval of DiveDay, which is in progress. Nothing to do yet — trip reminders keep going out as SMS until it clears.

signup.blocked: Meta's window could not open. Check that your browser isn't blocking pop-ups, then try again.
